title: Polyaniline-based ternary composites for the photocatalytic degradation of organic pollutants in wastewater: multifunctional properties, synthetic routes, and mechanistic insights
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00570A, Critical Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jyoti Kumari, Adarsh Singh, Akash Rawat, Suneel Kumar Srivastava, Ashok Kumar Gupta
Widespread use of pharmaceuticals, pesticides, dyes, and industrial chemicals has heavily polluted global water resources. Polyaniline-based ternary composites offer a promising approach for photocatalytic degradation of organic pollutants in wastewater.
